environment.description: EKS pod running in namespace 'user-services' with default service account. Container image based on python:3.11-slim. Pod spec uses securityContext with runAsUser: 1000 (non-root). Volume mount at /app/data with hostPath type DirectoryOrCreate pointing to node filesystem /var/lib/app-data. No PodSecurityPolicy or PodSecurityStandard enforcement. Container filesystem is writable. The gRPC port 50051 is exposed via ClusterIP service.
